program='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_colors = {r: grid[r][0] for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1}
    col_colors = {c: grid[0][c] for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1}
    common = set(row_colors.values()) & set(col_colors.values())
    sep = max(common, key=lambda color: sum(v == color for v in row_colors.values()) + sum(v == color for v in col_colors.values()))
    rseps = [r for r, color in row_colors.items() if color == sep]
    cseps = [c for c, color in col_colors.items() if color == sep]
    rparts = []
    start = 0
    for r in rseps:
        if start < r:
            rparts.append((start, r))
        start = r + 1
    if start < h:
        rparts.append((start, h))
    cparts = []
    start = 0
    for c in cseps:
        if start < c:
            cparts.append((start, c))
        start = c + 1
    if start < w:
        cparts.append((start, w))
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in rparts:
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in cparts:
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            base = Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
            row.append(1 if sum(v != base for v in vals) > 1 else base)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
